a.lede: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.
a.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: The San Jose, California, branch of Denny's once featured a plaque commemorating the booth where Jensen Huang and his two other co-founders worked to build Nvidia.
b.title: Commemorative plaque at Denny’s booth where Nvidia was born has been removed in wake of Jensen Huang scandals
